description: One manifest document per build_pairs.py run. The 'folds' array holds one object per fold (fold1, fold2, final). Contract section 2a fields are required on every fold object; additional fields are this lane's embargo / twin-ledger / new-player accounting and are explicitly allowed, never a substitute for a required field. Season keys are YYYY-YY strings; season-start-year is the first four digits. The frozen test season is 2025-26 in every fold object. Row counts in every fold object must reconcile: n_train_rows + n_embargo_rows + n_val_rows + n_test_rows + n_unused_rows equals the document's total_rows (12,966 for the verified vectors file).

embargo.description: True = hard one-season embargo applied (default, recommended). False = purge-only variant from --no-embargo; the two variants must never be mixed within one report.

features_file.description: Path of the vectors-style metadata file the manifest was built from (read-only input).

embargo_seasons.description: Extra. The one season removed from training as a hard embargo gap (empty in purge-only mode). fold1 = [2021-22], fold2 = [2023-24], final = [2024-25].

fold.description: fold1 and fold2 are tuning folds; final is the frozen-test protocol (val_seasons empty, n_val_rows 0).

n_embargo_rows.description: Extra. Rows in the embargo season(s).

n_pairs_adjacent.description: Train-internal adjacent-season positive pairs (both endpoints in the train set, same person_id, consecutive seasons). fold1 embargoed = 8166, fold2 embargoed = 8934, final embargoed = 9317.

n_pairs_dropped_cross_boundary.description: Adjacent pairs dropped because they cross into the first held-out season (embargo->val in embargoed mode, train->val/test in purge-only mode; the same physical pair either way). fold1 = 378, fold2 = 393, final = 397.

n_pairs_dropped_embargo_only.description: Extra. Train->embargo adjacent pairs withheld solely by the embargo (fold1 = 390, fold2 = 383, final = 393; 0 in purge-only mode). Distinct from n_pairs_dropped_cross_boundary; the two sum to all adjacent pairs withheld from training at the train-side boundary.

n_pairs_twin.description: Emitted v5-twin positive pairs (both endpoints in train, different person, not already adjacent). 0 for every fold when the only twin file is the test-only champion_twins_test.json; that is the correct filtered result, not an error, unless --fail-on-zero-twins was used.

n_test_new_player_rows.description: Extra. Test rows whose person_id has no earlier-season row in the fold's training portion. The meaningful new-player count for the final fold (embargoed = 147, purge-only = 83).

n_test_rows.description: Rows in the frozen test season 2025-26.

n_train_rows.description: Rows in the fold's train set (post-embargo when embargo is true).

n_twin_pairs_dropped.description: Extra. Twin pairs not emitted (anchor/target not in train, same person, self, or duplicate of an adjacent pair). For the test-only twin file this equals n_twin_pairs_seen.

n_twin_pairs_seen.description: Extra. Total twin pairs inspected in the twin file across all anchors (9910 for champion_twins_test.json).

n_val_new_player_rows.description: Val rows whose person_id has no earlier-season row in the fold's training portion. Reported as a separate slice everywhere, never blended into headline numbers. final = 0 (no val set); use n_test_new_player_rows for the final fold's test slice.

n_val_rows.description: Rows in the fold's val set. fold1 = 948, fold2 = 500, final = 0. NOTE: contract section 2a's '984' for fold2 val does not reconcile (see FOLDS.md section 0); the implemented value is 500 and the contract figure must be amended before training.

test_seasons.description: Frozen test seasons. Always ["2025-26"] in every fold object. Test rows are never trained on, never tuned on, never used for early stopping in any fold.

train_seasons.description: Seasons whose rows are in the fold's train set, ascending. Disjoint from embargo_seasons, val_seasons, and test_seasons.

twin_drop_ledger.description: Extra. Counter breakdown of twin-pair dispositions: seen, dropped_anchor_not_in_train, dropped_target_not_in_train, dropped_same_person, dropped_self, dropped_duplicate_adjacent, anchor_not_in_file.

unused_seasons.description: Extra. Seasons in neither train, embargo, val, nor test for this fold (fold1: [2024-25], future data at fold1's horizon; otherwise empty).

val_seasons.description: Seasons whose rows are the fold's validation set. fold1: two seasons (2022-23, 2023-24). fold2: one season (2024-25). final: empty.

generated_by.description: Script path and draft status that produced this manifest.

schema_version.description: Bump only on a breaking change to the fold object shape.

total_rows.description: Total player-season rows in the features file. build_pairs.py fails if the file total differs (unless --no-count-check).

twin_file.description: Path of the v5 twin file, or null if none was supplied. A test-only twin file yields n_pairs_twin = 0; see the twin_drop_ledger.

title: MLOps v2 fold manifest (Lane 3 produces; Lanes 4, 5 consume)
